English: COVID-19 mitigation strategies have been challenging to implement in resource-limited settings such as Malawi due to the potential for widespread disruption to social and economic well-being.
Luganda: Ebikolebwa mu kulwanyisa okusaasaana kwa COVID-19 bibadde bisoomooza okussa mu nkola mu mawanga agatalina bulungi ssente nga Malawi olw’ebiyinza okubaawo mu kutaataaganya kw’embeera z’abantu.
Yoruba: Ìpìlẹ̀ ète ìmú àdíkù bá agbára COVID-19 ti nira láti ṣe ní irú àwùjọ tí kò ní ohun èlo bíì orílẹ̀-èdè Malawi látàrí ipa ìtànká dàrúdàpọ̀ ẹ̀tò àwùjọ àti ìgbáyégbádùn ètò ọrọ̀-aje.
Zulu: Amasu ayisendlalelo okunciphisa i-COVID-19 abeyinselele ukuwasebenzisa ezindaweni ezinomkhawulo wezinsiza ezifana neMalawi ngenxa yokuphazamiseka okusabalele kwenhlalakahle yezenhlalo nezomnotho.
Hausa: Dabarun rage cutar COVID-19 sun kasance ƙalubale don aiwatarwa a cikin iyakantattun wuraren masu ƙarancin albarkatu kamar ƙasar Malawi saboda yiwuwar yaɗuwar tarzoma ga walwalar zamantakewa da kuma lafiyar tattalin arziƙi.
Northern Sotho: Maano a phokotšo ya phetetšo ya COVID-19 a bile ao a nago le ditlhohlo go ka a phethagatša ka mafelong a go hloka methopo a go swana le ka Malawi ka lebaka la kgonagalo ya tšhitišo ye e tletšego go tša leago le go phela gabotse ga batho ekonoming.
Amharic: የጀርባ ታሪክ፡- እንደ ማላዊ ባሉ ባለ ውስን ሃብት ቦታዎች በማህበራዊ እና ኢኮኖሚያዊ ደህነነት ላይ ሰፊ መቆራረጥን ሊያስከትል ስለሚችል የኮቪድ-19ን የቅነሳ ስልቶች መተግበር ፈታኝ ሆኖ ቆይቷል፡፡

English: Here we estimate the clinical severity of COVID-19 in Malawi, quantifying the potential impact of intervention strategies and increases in health system capacity.
Luganda: Wano tuteebereza obukambwe bw’ekisawo obwa COVID-19 mu Malawi, nga tubalirira ebiyinza okuva mu bikolebwa mu kumulwanyisa n’okweyongera mu busobozi bw’obujjanjabi.
Yoruba: Níbí, a ṣe ìṣirò bí ààrun COVID-19 ṣe gbópọn lórí ìlera tó ní orílẹ̀-èdè Màláwì, a ṣe ìwọ̀n ipa pàtàkì ìgbésẹ̀ àti àlékún ipa agbára ètò ìlera.
Zulu: Lapha silinganisela ubukhali bomtholampilo be-COVID-19 eMalawi, sibala umthelela ongaba khona wamasu okungenelela kanye nokwenyuka kwamandla esistimu yezempilo.
Hausa: A nan mun ƙiyasata tsananin cutar COVID-19 na asibiti a Malawi, inda muka ƙididdige tasirin dabarun sa-baki da haɓaka ƙarfin tsarin kiwon lafiya.
Northern Sotho: Mo re akanya go keka ga tša maphelo a COVID-19 ka Malawi, fao re elago kgonagalo ya seabe sa maano tsenogare le go oketšega ga bokgoni bja lenaneo la tša maphelo.
Amharic: እዚህ ጋር የጣልቃገብነት ስልቶች ሊያስከትሉ የሚችሉትን ተጽእኖ በመለካት እና የጤና ስርአት አቅምን በመጨመር በማላዊ የኮቪድ-19ን ክሊኒካዊ ክብደት እነገምታለን።

English: The infection fatality ratios (IFR) in Malawi were estimated by adjusting reported IFR for China accounting for demography, the current prevalence of comorbidities and health system capacity.
Luganda: Emiwendo gy’abantu abafa obulwadde buno (IFR) mu Malawi gyateeberezebwa nga tukyusa mu miwendo gy’abantu abafa mu China nga tulowooza ku bikwata ku bantu, abantu abalina IFR awamu n’endwadde endala mu kiseera ekyo n’obusobozi bw’obujjanjabi obuliwo.
Yoruba: Ìwọ̀n ìkọlù tó yọrí síkú (IFR) ní orílẹ̀-èdè Malawi jẹ́ ṣíṣírò nípa ìṣàtúnṣe IFR tí a jábọ̀ lórí orílẹ̀-èdè China tí ó ṣèsirò àkọsílẹ̀ ẹ̀dá ẹ̀nìyàn, ìwọ́pọ̀ àìsàn-oníbejì lọ́wọ́lọ́wọ́ àti agbára ètò ìlera.
Zulu: I-infection fatality ratios (IFR) e-Malawi yalinganiselwa ngokulungisa i-IFR ebikiwe ye-China accounting ye-demografia, ukwanda kwamanje kwe-comorbidities namandla wesistimu yezempilo.
Hausa: An ƙiyasta adadin kamuwa da mace-macen (IFR) a ƙasar Malawi ta hanyar daidaita rahoton IFR domin lissafin halayen mutane na ƙasar Sin, yadda ake yawan kamuwa da cututtuka biyu da kuma ƙarfin tsarin kiwon lafiya na yanzu.
Northern Sotho: Dipalopalo tša mahu ao a bakwago ke diphetetšo (IFR) ka Malawi di ile tša akanywa ka go beakanya leswa IFR ye e begilwego ka China ele ge go dirwa dipalopalo ka ga setšhaba, go tlala ga bjale ga malwetši a go iphihla bathong le bokgoni bja lenaneo la tša maphelo.
Amharic: ዘዴዎች፡- በማላዊ የኢንፌክሽን የሞት መጠን (ኢ.ሞ.መ) በቻይና ሪፖርት የተደረገውን ኢ.ሞ.መ በማስተካከል ስነ-ህዝብን ጨምሮ፣ አሁን ላይ ያለው የተዛማጅ በሸታዎች መስፋፋት እና የጤና ስረአት አቅም፡፡

English: These estimates were input into an age-structured deterministic model, which simulated the epidemic trajectory with non-pharmaceutical interventions.
Luganda: Ebiteeberezo bino byayingizibwa mu mutetenkanyirizo oguzuula emyaka, nga guno gwateebereza ebiva mu kirwadde nga waliwo ebikoleddwa mu kukirwanyisa ebitali ddagala.
Yoruba: Àwọn ìṣirò yìí jẹ́ fífi sí inú àwòṣe ajẹmọ́pinnu alátò-ọjọ́ orí, tí ó ṣàfihàn ipa àjàkálẹ̀ ààrùn pẹ̀lú àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ aláìjẹmóògùn.
Zulu: Lezi zilinganiso zifakwe kumodeli ye-deterministic yesakhiwo sobudala, elingisa umgudu wobhubhane ngokungenelela okungekhona okwemithi.
Hausa: An shigar da waɗannan ƙiyasi a cikin ƙirar tsararrun ƙayyadaddun shekaru, wanda ya kwaikwayi yanayin annoba tare da matakan sa-baki da ba na magunguna ba.
Northern Sotho: Dikakanyo tše di ile tša tsenywa ka gare ga mokgwa wa go hlatha mengwaga ya batho, wo o ekišitšego mokgwa wa leuba le ka ditsenogare tšeo di sego tša kalafo ka dihlare.
Amharic: እነዚህ ግምቶች በእድሜ የተዋቀረ የመወሳኛ ሞዴል ውስጥ የተካከተቱ ሲሆን ወረርሽኙን ፋርማሲዩቲካል ካልሆኑ ጣልቃገብነቶች ጋር አመሳስለውታል።

English: The impact of a novel therapeutic agent and increases in hospital capacity and oxygen availability were explored, given different assumptions on mortality rates.
Luganda: Ebiva mu ddagala eppya n’okweyongera mu busobozi bw’amalwaliro n’okubeerawo kw’omukka ogussibwa byetegerezebwa, ne bikolebwako okuteeberezebwa okw’enjawulo ku miwendo gy’abantu abafa.
Yoruba: Ipa onígbọ̀wọ́ ìwòsàn tí a ṣẹ̀ṣẹ̀ mọ̀ àti àlékún lórí iye agbára èrò ilé ìwòsàn àti ìwàlárọ̀ọ́wọ́tó atẹ́gùn-èémí jẹ́ wíwokiri, nípa ríro ọ̀pọ̀lọpọ̀ àwọn èrò lórí iye ìṣẹ̀lẹ̀ ikú.
Zulu: Umthelela we-ejenti yokwelapha inoveli kanye nokwanda komthamo wesibhedlela kanye nokutholakala komoyampilo kuye kwahlolisiswa, kunikezwe imibono ehlukene mayelana namazinga okufa.
Hausa: An binciko tasirin wani sabon maganin warkewa da haɓaka ƙarfin asibiti da wadatar iskar shaƙa, waɗanda aka bayar da hasashe daban-daban a kan adadin mace-mace.
Northern Sotho: Seabe sa sedirišwa sa kalafo seo e lego la mathomo se šomišwa le dikoketšego tša bokgoni bja dipetlele le go hwetšagala ga oksitšene di ile tša dirišwa, ka lebaka la dikakanyo tša go fapana tša mabapi le dipalopalo tša mahu.
Amharic: በሟችነት ምጥነት ላይ የተለያዩ ግምቶች በተሰጡበት ሁኔታ አዲስ የህክምና ወኪል ተጽእኖ፣ የጤና አቅም መጨመር እና የኦክሲጅን መኖር ተዳሶ ነበር።

English: The estimated age-specific IFR in Malawi are higher than those reported for China, however the younger average age of the population results in a slightly lower population-weighted IFR (0.48%, 95% uncertainty interval [UI] 0.30% – 0.72% compared with 0.60%, 95% CI 0.4% – 1.3% in China).
Luganda: Emiwendo egiteeberezebwa egy’abantu abafa IFR okusinziira ku myaka mu Malawi giri waggulu ku egyo egya China, wabula eky’okuba ng’emyaka gy’abantu mu ggwanga lino giri wansiko kireetera emiwendo egiteebereberezebwa egy’abantu abafa okuba nga giri wansiko IFR (0.48%, 95% ekigero ekiteekakasika [UI] 0.30% – 0.72% bw’ogeraageranya ne 0.60%, 95% CI 0.4% – 1.3% mu China).
Yoruba: Ìṣirò ajẹmọ́jọ́-orí nìkan IFR ní orílẹ̀-èdè Màláwì ga ju àwọn tí wọ́n jábọ̀ ní China lọ, bákan náà, ìwọ̀n ojọ́ orí tí ó kéré jù nínú àwọn èsì tí ó wọ́pọ̀ jù nínú ìye ọjọ́ orí tí ó gbénu lọlẹ̀ díẹ̀ – ṣègbéléwọn IFR (0.48%, 95% àlààfo tí kò dájú [UI] 0.30% – 0.72% tí a bá fi wé 0.60%, 95% CI 0.4% – 1.3% ní orílẹ̀-èdè China).
Zulu: Okutholakele I-IFR eqondene neminyaka ethile e-Malawi ingaphezulu kwaleyo ebikiwe e-China, nokho isilinganiso sobudala esincane sabantu siphumela ku-IFR enesisindo esincane sabantu (0.48%, 95% isikhawu sokungaqiniseki [[[UI] 0.30% - 0.72% uma kuqhathaniswa no-0.60%, 95% CI 0.4% - 1.3% eChina).
Hausa: Ƙiyasin ƙayyadaddun shekarun na musamman IFR a ƙasar Malawi ya fi waɗanda aka ruwaito na ƙasar Sin, duk da hak,a matsakaicin ƙarancin’shekarun yawan jama'a yana haifar da ƙarancin nauyin yawan jama’a IFR (0.48%, 95% tazarar rashin tabbas [[[UI] 0.30% – 0.72% idan aka kwatanta da 0.60%, 95% CI 0.4% – 1.3% a ƙasar Sin).
Northern Sotho: IFR ya go hlatha mengwaga yeo e akantšwego ka Malawi e bile godingwana go feta tšeo di begilwego ka China, le ge go le bjale mengwaga ya fasana ya tlwaelo ya dipoelo tša setšhaba ka go setšhaba seo se etšwego ka IFR (e bile 0.48%, 95% sebaka sa go hloka bonnete [UI] 0.30% – 0.72% ge go bapetšwa le 0.60%, 95% CI 0.4% – 1.3% ka China).
Amharic: ግኝቶች፡- በማላዊ የተገመተው ዕድሜ-ተኮር  ኢ.ሞ.መ በቻይና ሪፖርት ከተደረጉት በላይ ከፍተኛ ነበር፤ ነገር ግን የህብረተሰቡ የወጣት አማካይ እድሜ ዝቅተኛ የህዝብ ክብደት ያለውን ኢ.ሞ.መ ያመጣል (0.48%፣ 95% እርግጠኛ ያለመሆን ክፍተት [UI] 0.30% – 0.72% ከቻይና ጋር ሲወዳደር 0.60%፣ 95% CI 0.4% – 1.3%)፡፡

English: The current interventions implemented, (i.e. social distancing, workplace closures and public transport restrictions) could potentially avert 3,100 deaths (95% UI 1,500 – 4,500) over the course of the epidemic.
Luganda: Ebikolebwa mu kiseera kino, (i.e. okwewa amabanga, okuggala ebifo awakolerwa emirimu n’okukugira ebyentambula) biyinza okutaasa abantu 3,100 abandifudde (95% UI 1,500 – 4,500) mu kiseera ky’obulwadde buno.
Yoruba: Ìgbésẹ̀ àkókò yìí tí a ṣe, (i.e ìjìnnà síra ẹni láwùjọ, ìtìpa àwọn ibi iṣẹ́ àti ìfofinde ọkọ̀ èèrò) lè bí ikú 3,100 (95% UI 1,500 – 4,500) látàrí àjàkálẹ̀ ààrùn náà.
Zulu: Ukungenelela kwamanje okusetshenzisiwe, (okungukuthi, ukusatshalaliswa komphakathi, ukuvalwa kwendawo yokusebenza kanye nemikhawulo yezokuthutha zomphakathi) kungase kugwemeke ukufa kwabantu abangu-3,100 (95% UI 1,500 - 4,500) phakathi nalolu bhubhane.
Hausa: Ayyukan sa-baki da aka aiwatar na yanzu, (watau nisantar juna da rufe wuraren aiki da hana zirga-zirgar jama’a) suna iya yiwuwar kawar da mutuwar 3,100 (95% UI 1,500 – 4,500) a tsawon lokacin annobar.
Northern Sotho: Ditsenogare tša bjale di ile tša dirišwa, (ke gore, ka go tlogela sekgoba magareng ga batho, go tswalelwa ga mafelo a mošomo le dikiletšo go dinamelwa tša bohlwe) go na le kgonagalo ya gore di ka efoga mahu a 3,100 (95% UI 1,500 – 4,500) ka nakong ya leuba.
Amharic: አሁን ላይ የተተገበሩት ጣልቃገብነቶች (ማለትም ማህበራዊ ርቀትን መጠበቅ፣ የስራ ቦታዎች መዘጋት እና የህዝብ መመላለሻ ገደቦች) ወረርሽኙ በሚቆይበት ጊዜ የ3,100 ሰዎችን ሞት መከላከል ይችላል (95% እ.ያ.ክ 1,500 – 4,500)።

English: Enhanced shielding of people aged ≥ 60 years could avert a further 30,500 deaths (95% UI 17,500 – 45,600) and halve ICU admissions at the peak of the outbreak.
Luganda: Okwongera okukuuma abantu ab’emyaka ≥ 60 kiyinza okutaasa abantu abalala 30,500 abandifudde (95% UI 17,500 – 45,600) n’okusalako kimu kyakubiri eky’abalwadde abatwalibwa mu busenge bw’abayi ku ntikko y’obulwadde.
Yoruba: Ìfẹ̀lójú ìsémọ́lé bo àwọn ènìyàn ≥ 60 lọ́jọ́ orí lè tẹ̀síwájú láti fa ikú 30,500 (95% UI 17,500 – 45,600) àti ìdàjì ìgbaniwọléèwòsàn ICU ní ìgbà tí àjàkálẹ̀ náà le koko.
Zulu: Ukuvikela okuthuthukisiwe kwabantu abaneminyaka engu-≥ iminyaka engama-60 kunganqanda okunye ukufa okungama-30,500 (95% UI 17,500 - 45,600) futhi kunciphise ukungeniswa e-ICU ngesikhathi sokuqubuka kwalesi sifo.
Hausa: Inganta garkuwar jikin mutane masu shekaru ≥ 60 yana iya hana ƙarin mutuwar 30,500 (95% UI 17,500 – 45,600) da kuma rabin shigar ICU a ƙololuwar ɓarkewar.
Northern Sotho: Go šireletša batho ba mengwaga ye ≥ 60 ka fao go maatlafaditšwego go ka efoga gape mahu a mangwe a 30,500 (95% UI 17,500 – 45,600) le go fokotša go amogelwa ga malwetši ka ICU ka dipetlele ka seripagare ka nakong ya ge bolwetši bjo bo hlatlogetše godimo.
Amharic: እድሜያቸው ≥ 60 ዓመት ለሆኑ ሰዎች የተሻሻለ መከላከያ ተጨማሪ 30,500 ሞቶችን (5% እ.ያ.ክ 17,500 – 45,600) እና በወረርሽኙ ከፍተኛ ደረጃ ላይ የአይሲዩ መግባቶችን በግማሽ ሊቀንስ ይችላል።

Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da rahoton mutuwar mutane da yawa, musamman a tsakanin matasa, a ƙasar Malawi fiye da ƙasar Sin.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile mahu a mantši, kudukudu magareng ga bafsa, ka Malawi go feta ka China.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ በተለይም በማላዊ እና በቻይና ባሉ ወጣት ሰዎች ላይ የበለጡ ሞቶች እንዳሉ ዘግበዋል።

English: They said interventions that were implemented, for example, people standing 2 metres apart, people not going to work and restrictions on taxis and buses, could save 3 100 lives.
Luganda: Baagamba nti ebyakolebwa, okugeza, abantu okuyimirira nga beesudde mmita 2, abantu obutagenda ku mirimu n’okukugira takisi ne baasi, byali bisobola okutaasa abantu 3 100 obutafa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ tí wọ́n ṣàmúlò, fún àpẹẹrẹ, àwọn ènìyàn tí wọn ń dúró ní mítà 2 sí ara wọn, àwọn ènìyàn tí wọn kò lọ sí ibi isẹ́ àti ìfofinde àwọn ọkọ̀ ayọ́kẹ́lé akérò àti àwọn ọkọ̀ gbọọrọ akérò, lè gba ẹ̀mí 3 100 là.
Zulu: Bathe ukungenelela okwenziwayo, isibonelo, abantu abaqhelelene ngamamitha angu-2, abantu abangayi emsebenzini nokuvinjelwa kwamatekisi namabhasi, kungahlenga imiphefumulo engu-3 100.
Hausa: Sun ce matakan sa-baki da aka aiwatar, alal misali, mutanen su tsaya a tsakanin mitoci 2, mutane ba sa zuwa aiki da kuma hana motocin haya da motocin bas, yana iya ceton rayuka 3 100.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ditsenogare tšeo di phethagaditšwego, go fa mohlala, batho ge ba ema dimetara tše 2 ba tlogelane, batho ge ba sa ye mošomong le dikiletšo dithekising le ka dipeseng, go ka phološa maphelo a 3 100.
Amharic: ለምሳሌ የ2ሜትር ርቀትን ጠብቆ መቆም፣ ሰዎች ወደስራ መሄድ ማቆማቸው እና ታክሲዎች እና ባሶች ላይ ያሉ ገደቦችን የመሰሉ የተተገበሩ ጣልቃገብነቶች 3100 ህይወቶችን ሊያድኑ ይችላሉ ብለዋል።

English: With those interventions, the researchers estimated about 4 deaths per 1 000 people in 250 days.
Luganda: Ebikolebwa bino nga biteereddwa mu nkola, abanoonyereza baateebereza abantu abafa 4 ku buli bantu 1 000 mu nnaku 250.
Yoruba: Pẹ̀lú àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ wọ̀nyìí, àwọn aṣèwádìí ṣe ìṣirò bíi Ikú 4 láàrin ènìyàn 1 000 kọ̀ọ̀kan ní ààrín ọjọ́ 250.
Zulu: Ngalokho kungenelela, abacwaningi balinganisela ukufa kwabantu aba-4 kubantu abayi-1 000 ngezinsuku ezingama-250.
Hausa: Tare da waɗannan ayyukan sa-baki, masu binciken sun ƙiyasta kimanin mutuwar 4 a cikin mutane 1 000 a cikin kwanaki 250.
Northern Sotho: Ka ditsenogare tšeo, banyakišiši ba akantše mahu ao a ka bago a 4 go batho ba 1 000 mo matšatšing a 250.
Amharic: በእነዛ ጣልቃገብነቶች ተመራማሪዎቹ በ250 ቀናት ውስጥ በ1000 ሰው 4 ሞትን ገምተዋል።

English: They said if the elderly could be given extra protection from the virus many deaths could be avoided, and ICU admissions reduced by half.
Luganda: Baagamba nti singa abantu abakulu baba basobola okuweebwa obukuumi obusingako eri akawuka abantu bangi banditaasiddwa okufa, era n’abateebwa mu kasenge k’abayi bandikendeezeddwa ekitundu kimu kyakubiri.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé tí ààbò àwọn agbàlàgbà bá gbópọn síi lọ́wọ́ kò́kòrò fáírọ́ọ̀sì náà, púpọ̀ ikú ni yóò dèènà, àti ìgbaniwọléèwòsàn ICU yóò dínkù pẹ̀lú ìdajì.
Zulu: Bathe uma izaguga zinganikezwa ukuvikeleka okwengeziwe kuleli gciwane kungagwemeka ukufa kwabantu abaningi, nokungeniswa e-ICU kwehle ngesigamu.
Hausa: Haka kuma sun ce idan za a iya ba wa tsofaffi ƙarin kariya daga ƙwayar cutar za a iya guje wa mutuwar mutane da yawa, kuma shigar da mutane ICU ta ragu da rabi.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore ge batšofadi ba ka fiwa tšhireletšo ya tlaleletšo go baerase ye mahu a mantši a ka efogwa, le go amogela balwetši ka ICU go ka fokotšwa ka seripagare.
Amharic: አረጋውያን ከቫይረሱ ተጨማሪ ጥበቃ ሊሰጣቸው ከቻለ ብዙ ብሽታዎች ሊወገዱ ይችላሉ፤ የአይሲዩ መግባቶች ደግሞ በግማሽ ሊቀንሱ ይችላሉ ብለዋል።

English: They also suggested that if at least 60% of the population could wear masks, Covid-19 could be controlled.
Luganda: Era baagamba nti singa waakiri ebitundu 60% eby’abantu basobola okwambala obukookolo, Covid-19 yandibadde alwanyisibwa.
Yoruba: Wọ́n tún dábàá pé tí ó bá jé pé ó kéré tán 60% iye àwọn ènìyàn lè wọ ìbòjú, a lè dèènà Covid-19.
Zulu: Baphinde baphakamisa ukuthi uma okungenani u-60% wabantu bengagqoka imaski, i-Covid-19 ingalawulwa.
Hausa: Haka nan sun kuma bayar da shawarar cewa idan aƙalla kashi 60% na jama'a za su iya sanya abin rufe fuska, za a iya sarrafa cutar Covid-19.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile ba šišinya gape gore ge bonyane 60% ya setšhaba e ka kgona go apara dimaseke, Covid-19 e ka laolwa.
Amharic: በተጨማሪም ቢያንስ 60% የሚሆነው ህዝብ ማስኮችን ማድረግ ከቻለ ኮቪድ-19 በቁጥጥር ስር ሊውል ይችላል።

English: The researchers reported that if a Covid-19 medicine that could reduce death rates by 65%, and reduce the number of very sick people by 80%, could be found, the death rate could be reduced to just 2.55%.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti singa eddagala lya Covid-19 erisobola okukendeeza abantu abafa n’ebitundu 65%, n’okukendeeza omuwendo gw’abantu abalwadde ennyo ebitundu 80%, liba lisobola okuzuulibwa, omuwendo gw’abantu abafa gwandibadde gukendeezebwa okutuuka ku bitundu 2.55% byokka.
Yoruba: Àwọn Aṣèwádìí náà jẹ́rìí pé tí ó bá jẹ́ pé oògùn Covid-19 tí ó lè mú àdínkù bá iye ikú pẹ̀lú 65% àti èyí tí ó lè mú àdínkù bá iye àwọn tí wọn ń ṣàìṣàn gidi gan-an sí 80% lè di bíbá pàdé, iye ikú náà lè di dídínkù sí 2.55% lásán.
Zulu: Abacwaningi babike ukuthi uma kungatholakala umuthi we-Covid-19 onganciphisa izinga lokufa ngo-65%, futhi wehlise isibalo sabantu abagula kakhulu ngo-80%, izinga lokufa lingehliswa libe ngu-2.55% kuphela.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun bayar da rahoton cewa idan aka gano maganin cutar Covid-19 wanda zai iya rage adadin masu mutuwa da kashi 65%, kuma ya rage adadin masu fama da rashin lafiya da kashi 80%, za a iya rage adadin mutuwar zuwa kashi 2.55 kawai.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba begile gore ge dihlare tša Covid-19 ge di kgona go fokotša dipalopalo tša mahu ka 65%, le go fokotša palo ya batho ba go lwala kudu ka 80%, di ka hwetšwa, dipalopalo tša mahu di ka fokotšwa ka fela 2.55%.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች የሞት ምጥነቶችን በ65% ሊቀንስ የሚችል እና በጣም የታመሙ ሰዎችን ቁጥር በ80% መቀነስ የሚችል የኮቪድ-19 መድሃኒት ከተገኘ የሞት ምጥነትን በ2.55% ብቻ ሊቀንስ ይችላል ብለዋል።

English: The researchers predicted that most infections would occur among those aged below 20 years, but would result in only 1.3% deaths in the same age group.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baateebereza nti abafuna obulwadde buno bandibadde abo bokka abali wansi w’emyaka 20, naye ng’abafa mu kibinja ky’emyaka gino bandibadde ebitundu 1.3% bokka.
Yoruba: Àwọn aṣèwádìí dábàá pé púpọ̀ àwọn ìkọlù yóò ṣẹlẹ̀ ní àárín àwọn ọjọ́ orí náà tí ó kéré sí ọdún 20, ṣ̣ùgbọ́n yóò yọrí sí ikú 1.3% nì àárín àwọn ọ̀wọ́ ọjọ́ orí kan náà.
Zulu: Abaphenyi babikezele ukuthi izifo eziningi zizokwenzeka kulabo abaneminyaka engaphansi kwengama-20, kodwa kuzoholela ekufeni kwabantu abayi-1.3% eqenjini elifanayo leminyaka.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi hasashen cewa yawancin kamuwa da cututtuka za su faru ne a tsakanin waɗanda shekarunsu ba su wuce 20 ba, amma zai haifar da mutuwar kashi 1.3% kawai a cikin rukuni guda.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba akantšwe gore diphetetšo tše ntši di ka direga gareng ga batho ba mengwaga ya ka fase ga ye 20, eupša se se ka feletša ka fela mahu a 1.3% ka go sehlopha sa mengwaga ye.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎች አብዛኛዎቹ ኢንፌክሽኖች 20ዓመት በታች በሆናቸው ሰዎች መካከል ሊከሰቱ እንደሚችሉ ተንብየዋል፤ ነገር ግን በዚሁ የእድሜ ክልል ውስጥ 1.3% ሞቶችን ሊያስከትል ይችላል።

English: They estimated more deaths among those aged above 70.
Luganda: Baateebereza omuwendo gw’abantu omungiko mu bantu abasussa emyaka 70.
Yoruba: Wọ́n ṣe ìṣirò ikú pùpọ̀ ní àárín àwọn ọjọ́ orí tí ó ju 70 lọ.
Zulu: Balinganise ukufa kwabantu abaningi phakathi kwalabo abaneminyaka engaphezu kwengama-70.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun yi ƙiyasin samu ƙarin mutuwar mutane ‘yan sama da shekaru 70.
Northern Sotho: Ba akantše gore go bile le mahu a mantši gareng ga batho ba mengwaga ya go feta ye 70.
Amharic: ከ70 ዓመት እድሜ በላይ ላላቸው የበለጠ ሞትን ገምተዋል።

English: The researchers said lockdown for long periods could reduce infections, and reduce deaths to just about 1 person in 1 000 people.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti omuggalo ogutwala ekiseera ekinene gusobola okukendeeza abafuna obulwadde, n’okukendeeza abafa okutuuka ku muntu 1 yekka mu bantu 1 000.
Yoruba: Àwọn Aṣèwádìí sọ pé ìsémọ́lé fún ìgbà pípẹ́ lè mú àdínkù bá ìkọlù, ki ó sì mú àdínkù bá iye ikú sí bí ènìyàn 1 láàrin ènìyàn 1 000.
Zulu: Abacwaningi bathi ukuvala isikhathi eside kunganciphisa izifo, futhi kwehlise ukufa kube cishe kumuntu oyedwa kubantu abayinkulungwane.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce kulle na tsawon lokaciya na iya rage kamuwa da cututtuka, da kuma rage mace-mace zuwa kusan mutum 1 a cikin 1000.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore dikiletšo tša mesepelo tša dinako tša go tšea dinako tše ditelele di ka fokotša diphetetšo, le go fokotša mahu go fihla go fela lehu la motho wo 1 go batho ba 1 000.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ረጅም ጊዜ የሚቆይ የእንቅስቃሴ እገዳ ኢንፌክሽኖችን ሊቀንስ ይችላል ብለዋል፤ ሞቶችን ደግሞ ከ1000 ሰዎች ውስጥ ወደ 1 የሰው ሞት ይቀንሳል።

English: They said infections would still occur after lockdown if other interventions are not implemented.
Luganda: Baagamba nti abantu era bandyeyongedde okulwala oluvannyuma lw’omuggalo singa ebikolebwa ebirala tebissibwa mu nkola.
Yoruba: Wọ́n sọ pé ìkọlù yóò tún wáyé lẹ́yìn ìṣémọ́lé tí àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ yòókù kò bá di mímúṣe.
Zulu: Bathe ukutheleleka kusazokwenzeka ngemuva kwe-Lockdown uma okunye ukungenelela kungenziwa.
Hausa: Sun ce har yanzu cututtuka suna iya faruwa bayan kulle idan ba a aiwatar da wasu matakan sa-bakin ba.
Northern Sotho: Ba boletše gore diphetetšo di tlo no ba gona ka morago ga ge magato a kiletšo ya mesepelo a phethagaditšwe ge ditsenogare tše dingwe di ka se phethagatšwe.
Amharic: ከእንቅስቃሴ እገዳም በኋላ ሌሎች ጣልቃገብነቶች ካልተተገበሩ ኢንፌክሽኖች መከሰታቸውን ይቀጥላሉ።

English: The researchers said imposing a lockdown in Malawi may not be possible because many people are poor and need to go out and work.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baagamba nti okussaawo omuggalo mu Malawi kiyinza obutasoboka kubanga abantu bangi baavu nga beetaaga okugenda okukola.
Yoruba: Àwọn Aṣèwádìí sọ pé pípàṣẹ ìsémolé ní orílẹ̀-èdè Malawi lè má ṣeéṣe nítorí pé púpọ̀ àwọn ènìyàn ni wọ́n tòṣì wọ́n sì nílò láti jáde lọ ṣiṣẹ́.
Zulu: Abaphenyi bathi ukuvala umlomo eMalawi kungenzeka kungenzeki ngoba abantu abaningi bampofu futhi badinga ukuphuma bayosebenza.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun ce sanya dokar hana fita a ƙasar Malawi ba zai yiwu ba saboda mutane da yawa talakawa ne kuma suna buƙatar fita da kuma yin aiki.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba boletše gore go phethagatša magato a kiletšo ya mesepelo ka Malawi a ka no se kgonagale ka ge batho ba bantši ba hloka gomme go hlokagala gore ba tšwe ba ye mešomong.
Amharic: ተመራመሪዎቹ ብዙ ሰዎች ድሃ ስለሆኑ እና ስራ መሄድ ስለሚያስፈልጋቸው ማላዊ ላይ የእንቅስቃሴ እገዳን መጫን ላይተገበር ይችላል ብለዋል።

English: But if hospital beds with oxygen could be increased by half, that would reduce the death rate.
Luganda: Naye singa ebitanda mu malwaliro ebirina omukka ogussibwa biba bisobola okwongezebwamu ekitundu kimu kyakubiri, ekyo kyandikendeezezza ku bantu abafa.
Yoruba: Ṣùgbọ́n tí àwọn ibùsùn ilé ìwòsàn bá lè di fífikún síi àti atẹ́gùn-èémí pẹ̀lú ìdajì, èyí yóò mú àdíkù bá iye ikú.
Zulu: Kodwa uma imibhede yasesibhedlela enomoya-mpilo inganyuswa ngesigamu, lokho kunganciphisa izinga lokufa.
Hausa: Amma idan ana iya ƙara gadajen asibiti masu ɗauke da iskar shaƙa da rabi, hakan zai rage yawan mace-mace.
Northern Sotho: Eupša ge mepete ya ka dipetlele yeo e nago le oksitšene e ka oketšwa ka seripagare, seo se ka fokotša dipalopalo tša mahu.
Amharic: ነገር ግን ኦክሲጅን ያላቸው የሆስፒታል አልጋዎች በግማሽ መጨመር ከቻሉ ይህ የሞት ምጥነቱን ይቀንሰዋል።

English: This study tried to predict the impact of Covid-19 interventions in Malawi, thereby contributing to global efforts to combat the disease.
Luganda: Okunoonyereza kuno kwagezaako okuteebereza ebiva mu bikolebwa okukendeeza Covid-19 mu Malawi, nga kino kyongera ku kaweefube w’okulwanyisa ekirwadde kino mu nsi yonna.
Yoruba: Iṣẹ́ ìwádìí yìí gbìyànjú láti sọ àsọdánwò ipa àwọn ìgbésẹ̀ ààrùn Covid-19 ní Malawi, léyìí tí yóò nípa lórí akitiyan àgbááyé láti gbógun ti ààrùn náà.
Zulu: Lolu cwaningo luzamile ukubikezela umthelela wokungenelela kwe-Covid-19 eMalawi, ngaleyo ndlela kube neqhaza emizamweni yomhlaba wonke yokulwa nalesi sifo.
Hausa: Wannan binciken ya yi ƙoƙarin yin hasashen tasirin ayyukan sa-baki na cutar Covid-19 a Malawi, don haka, ya bayar da gudummawa ga ƙoƙarin duniya na yaƙar cutar.
Northern Sotho: Dinyakišišo tše di lekile go akanya seabe sa ditsenogare tša Covid-19 ka Malawi, go realo se se tsenya letsogo go masolo a lefase ka bophara a go fediša bolwetši bjo.
Amharic: ይህ ጥናት በማላዊ የኮቪድ-19 ጣልቃገብነቶች ተጽእኖን ለመተንበይ ሞክሮ ነበር፤ በዚህም በሽታውን ለመከላከል ለሚደረገው አለም አቀፋዊ ጥረት አስተዋጽኦ ያደርጋል።
